dedupe_keys.name: us public facing medicaid enrolment office locations

description: This dataset maps public-facing Medicaid offices that offer in-person enrolment support across all fifty US states and the District of Columbia. Boston University researchers assembled addresses from state websites, geocoded them and checked unresolved locations. Collection began in 2021–2022 and was refreshed during August–December 2023. Harvard Dataverse version 4 lists 3,027 locations, including one Vermont office added after the article’s 3,026-location count, and documents coordinate corrections. TSV, XLSX and SAS transport files are public and free under CC BY-NC 4.0. Closely neighbouring offices are merged, and facilities serving only administrative or clinical functions are excluded. These rules and later office changes are limitations for interpreting coverage. Modellers could assess access distances or vulnerability of administrative health-service access to disruptions. data-ahrq-hcup-hospital-utilization-databases offers complementary healthcare-utilisation information. The named repository API supplied metadata despite an empty web response. No office table was downloaded or travel distance calculated.
